Manorama Industries Limited has informed the Exchange about Investor Presentation
voiceSummary: Manorama Industries Limited filed an investor presentation regarding its unaudited financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. For Q2FY27, consolidated revenue grew 41.9% year-on-year to INR 4,589 million. EBITDA rose 34.4% to INR 1,182 million. Profit after tax increased 51.8% to INR 808 million. For H1FY27, revenue grew 40.8% and PAT grew 59.2%. Exports accounted for 61% of H1FY27 revenue. The company highlighted a leadership transition and continued focus on capacity expansion. The presentation is available on the company website.

attchmntText: Manorama Industries Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated November 12, 2026, titled "Press Release".
voiceSummary: Manorama Industries Limited filed its press release on Unaudited Financial Results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. Consolidated revenue for Q2FY27 increased by 41.9% year-on-year to INR 4,588.6 million. EBITDA grew by 34.4% to INR 1,181.8 million. Profit after tax surged by 51.8% to INR 808.1 million. For the half year, revenue rose 40.8% to INR 8,628.7 million. PAT increased by 59.2% to INR 1,594.7 million. The company announced a leadership transition. Mr. Mudit Kumar Singh serves as Chairman. Mr. Deep Saraf is the Managing Director. Mr. Ashish Saraf is President of Strategic Planning and Business Development. Mrs. Vinita Saraf is President of Business Excellence and Development. The results are available on the company website.

Manorama Industries Limited filed the Monitoring Agency Report for the quarter ended September 30, 2026, regarding the Qualified Institutions Placement. Crisil Ratings Limited issued the report. The issue size was Rs 48,539.81 lakhs. The company utilized Rs 15,000.00 lakhs for working capital requirements. The remaining Rs 33,539.81 lakhs remains unutilized. These unutilized funds are invested in fixed deposits with Yes Bank and Bank of India. The maturity date for these deposits is January 2027. The total earnings on these investments as of September 30, 2026, amount to Rs 550.20 lakhs. There are no deviations from the objects disclosed in the offer document. No shareholder approval is required for material deviations. The report was submitted pursuant to SEBI regulations.

attchmntText: Manorama Industries Limited has informed the Exchange about statement of deviation(s) or variation(s) under Reg. 32
desc: Statement of deviation(s) or variation(s) under Reg. 32
voiceSummary: Manorama Industries Limited filed a statement of deviation or variation in the utilization of funds raised through a Qualified Institutions Placement for the quarter ended September 30, 2026. The company raised Rs 50,000 lakh via QIP on July 2, 2026. The statement confirms there is no deviation or variation in the use of funds. Funds were allocated to working capital requirements, general corporate purposes, and issue expenses. As of September 30, 2026, Rs 16,460.19 lakh was utilized. Rs 33,539.81 lakh remains unutilized. The Audit Committee and Board reviewed and approved the statement on November 12, 2026. CRISIL Ratings Limited is the monitoring agency.

attchmntText: Manorama Industries Limited has informed the Exchange regarding Appointment of Mr Mudit Kumar Singh as Chairman & Executive Director of the company w.e.f. November 12, 2026.
voiceSummary: Manorama Industries Limited board meeting held on November 12, 2026, approved unaudited financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. Mr. Ashish Ramesh Saraf ceased as Chairman and Managing Director and was redesignated as President, Strategic Planning and Business Development. Mrs. Vinita Ashish Saraf ceased as Vice Chairperson and Whole-time Director and was redesignated as President, Business Excellence and Development. The board approved the appointment of Mr. Deep Saraf as Additional Director, Executive Director, and Managing Director for five years, subject to shareholder approval. Mr. Mudit Kumar Singh was appointed as Additional Director, Executive Director, and Chairman of the Board for five years, subject to shareholder approval. A postal ballot notice was approved to seek member approval for these appointments and remuneration for the redesignated executives. The cut-off date for voting eligibility is November 20, 2026.

attchmntText: Manorama Industries Limited has informed the Exchange regarding Change in Director(s) of the company.
voiceSummary: Manorama Industries Limited board meeting on November 12, 2026, approved unaudited financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. attchmntText: Manorama Industries Limited has informed the Exchange about Schedule of meet
voiceSummary: Manorama Industries Limited will announce its Q2 and H1 FY27 results on Thursday, 12th November 2026. The company will host an Earnings Conference Call on Friday, 13th November 2026 at 1:30 PM IST. The call will last for 60 minutes. Participants can dial in using the provided national and international toll-free numbers. Pre-registration is available via email to receive confirmation details. The announcement was filed with the BSE and NSE under Regulation 30 of SEBI Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements Regulations, 2015. The letter was signed by Deepak Sharma, Company Secretary and Compliance Officer. The results and call details are also hosted on the company website.

attchmntText: Manorama Industries Limited has informed the Exchange about Credit Rating
voiceSummary: Manorama Industries Limited intimates that its bank loan facilities have been upgraded by India Ratings and Research Private Limited. The upgrade was communicated via a press release dated November 06, 2026. The rating for bank loan facilities of INR 4967.70 million is now IND A+ with a Positive outlook. The previous rating was IND A+. This information is being shared pursuant to Regulation 30 read with Schedule III of SEBI Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements Regulations, 2015. The intimation will also be hosted on the company website at https://manoramagroup.co.in/investors-company-announcements#credit_ratings. The announcement was signed by Deepak Sharma, Company Secretary and Compliance Officer, from Raipur.
